candidates.snippet: A Ukrainian "B-2" middle-strike drone missed, flying inches past a Russian car in occupied Zaporizhzhia region. It may have actually been aiming at the truck further left, which would mean a much bigger miss. https://t.co/xVLSy4wsFu

Putin's envoy Kirill Dmitriev called Trump's decision to pause sanctions on Russia "historic," claiming the Graham Act would have effectively halted US-Russia economic cooperation and hurt both the American economy and global markets.
Russian occupiers reportedly captured and executed Ukrainian POWs in the Huliaipole direction of Zaporizhzhia region, Ukraine's Prosecutor General's Office says. An investigation has been opened.
